cell_line.evidence: Peptide mixtures derived from digested HeLa cell extracts were injected in triplicates in an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer equipped with a chromatographic nano-UPLC system (Proxeon-1000) and a 50-cm C18 column (EASY-Spray; 75µm, PepMap RSLC C18, 2µm particles, 45ºC) using 120-min chromatographic gradients (ACN:H2O, 1% FA).
